summary: Iteration 608 tests all pass. Backend: 9/9 pytest — booking confirmation email i18n (TR/EN/DE with correct subject prefixes + html tokens Anreise/Giriş/Check-in), email_outbox + booking_email_log persistence, ab_variant stored on booking, upcoming-events (≤4, min-2-night check-out, dedup by icon+overlap, date-sorted, all label_en/tr/de present), OTA banner-view public log, config PUT/GET round-trip, OTA conversion returns ab {enabled,variant_b_pct=8, variants A/B with views/bookings/conversion_pct, winner=null, min_views_for_winner=20}. Frontend: events strip renders 4 cards on /book/default, be-event-book-* fills dates and shows ≥1 be-book-room-*; TR title switches to 'Yaklaşan etkinlikler — erken rezervasyon yapın'; localStorage be_ab_variant='B' → be-ota-banner-pct='8', 'A' → '5'; compare chip after search shows Expedia ~£270 / Direct £248 (248/(1-0.08)≈269.6). Admin Booking Engine Manager → Theme & Branding tab exposes ota-ab-config, theme-ab-toggle, theme-ab-b-pct. Admin OTA Commission (Channels & Distribution → ota-commission-btn) → ota-conversion-card contains ota-ab-card with ota-ab-status, ota-ab-variant-A and ota-ab-variant-B. Test bookings iter608* cleaned up from bookings/email_outbox/booking_email_log.

issues: When activePropertyId='all', backend has no widget config so ota-ab-status renders 'KAPALI' and direct_advantage_pct shows 7 (fleet default) instead of the per-property 5. Reviewer expected 'AKTİF' but that only appears when a specific property (e.g. Franziskaner=default) is selected. Consider aggregating theme flags across properties for the all-branches view, or falling back to any-property enabled state, otherwise the A/B badge is misleading in multi-property admins.

theme-ab-toggle checkbox visually appears unchecked on load even though GET /config/default returns ota_ab_enabled=true and widget correctly renders variant pct — please verify controlled checkbox reads Boolean(config.ota_ab_enabled) on mount (minor).

action_items: (Optional) In OTACommissionPanel, when activePropertyId==='all' pass a resolved property (e.g. first property) or aggregate ab.enabled=true if any property has it on, so the A/B badge reflects reality for multi-property admins.

(Optional) In BookingEngineAdmin Theme form, ensure the ota_ab_enabled checkbox is initialised from the API response (Boolean(config.ota_ab_enabled)) — currently appears unchecked despite backend having it enabled.
critical_code_review_comments: booking_widget.py upcoming_events dedup logic is correct: same icon + overlapping ranges skipped. Guarantee co-ci >= 2 nights confirmed.
guest_email_i18n.build_confirmation defaults lang to 'en' when unsupported — good.

ota_conversion sets ab.enabled from config lookup keyed by property_id; endpoint used with 'all' returns enabled=false because no wildcard config exists — this is correct backend behaviour but the frontend consumes it directly, causing the badge mismatch flagged above.
Resend mailer is MOCK by design (email_outbox insert with status='mocked') — confirmed and expected.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for widget flows; admin AKTİF badge shown correctly only when a specific property (not 'all') is selected
